subject: general
question: A certain number of men can finish a task in 70 days. If 10 more men are added to the existing staff, then the task can be finished in 10 days less. How many men were there originally?
solution:
**Given:**

A certain number of men can finish a task in 70 days. If 10 more men are added to the existing staff, then the task can be finished in 10 days less.

**Concept used:**

If x men take y days to finish a work, then one man alone can finish (1)/(xy) in 1 day.

**Calculation:**

Let the initial number of men be x.

Then, a man alone can complete (1)/(70x) part of the task in 1 day.

If 'x+10' can finish the task at the same rate in 60 days, then (x+10)times(1)/(70x)times 60=1 

Solving for x,

x=(600)/(10)=60

**∴ The initial number of men were 60.**
